name: codephi-podcast-card
mode: Code Phi reusable plugin (not SomaFM channel)

input.title: verified metadata or creator entry
input.quantPacket: original Infinity/Omni search token plus past searches/stars/collects

orderedTools.capability: bind original search + purple assimilation context
resolve public RSS and authorized provider metadata
render podcast-card with Share, Collect, Star
select mobile layout based on media and user task
Code Phi assembles, previews, and audits full page
verify creator and listener, reward/paid settlement receipts

fallbacks.noAudio: attributed official page link; no fake Play button
fallbacks.noWallet: first episode only; additional playback disabled
fallbacks.rssCors: ask for creator file or verified feed; never require purchased API keys
fallbacks.renderError: keep last working preview and show repair cue

completion: first free playable or legitimately linked episode visible
star/share/collect actions work but do not fabricate ledger credit
paid episode debit+creator credit use one authenticated idempotent server transaction
media-end/read-end events can request a new entitled card
Cloud Browser checks finished rendered page before Web Phi publish
